verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM ships a built-in Copilot that takes plain-English requests to configure pipelines, fields, automations and reports, and answers analyst-style questions with reports or dashboards. It has Auto/Strict execution modes and admin controls, including a deletion block that covers records, which implies it can act on records too. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of everyday record operations (creating or updating deals and contacts) via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
Ask what you would ask a sales analyst and get a report or a dashboard back.
Everyone starts in Auto and can switch to Strict in the chat whenever they want Copilot to ask first.
can block deletion entirely with a separate switch that covers records and configuration.
